name: ZCA_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES
description: ZCA_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES:   table would be used for registration of an import object attributes.

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Parent  foreign key refering to  ZCA_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE
columns.description: This specifies the language Independent code of object according to ZCA_OBJECTS table

columns.name: ENTITY_DEFINITION
columns.description: Enity Definition for the corresponding Attribute

columns.name: ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Name of the attribute in base table.

columns.name: ATTR_COLUMN
columns.description: Underlying  column of the attribute in base table.

columns.name: ATTR_TABLE
columns.description: Name of the base  table of the attribute.

columns.name: ATTR_TYPE
columns.description: Data type of the attribute in the ADF base VO

columns.name: COLUMN_TYPE
columns.description: Data type of the underlying column in the database

columns.name: ATTR_LENGTH
columns.description: Length of the ViewObject(VO) attribute

columns.name: ATTR_SCALE
columns.description: Scale of the ViewObject(VO)  attribute

columns.name: ATTR_PRECISION
columns.description: Precision of the ViewObject(VO)  attribute

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag specifying whether the attribute is mandatory or not

columns.name: UPDATABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag specifying whether the attribute can be updated or not

columns.name: CUSTOM_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this is a custom attribute

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this is a PK attribute

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_NUM
columns.description: Specifies the PK Number attribute. The sequence of the attribute in PK.

columns.name: PUID_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this is a PUID attribute

columns.name: PARENT_PUID_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this is a Parent PUID attribute.

columns.name: PARENT_FK_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this is a Parent PK attribute

columns.name: PARENT_FK_NUM
columns.description: Specifies the Parent PK Number attribute. The sequence of the attribute in parent pk

columns.name: TRANSIENT_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether the Attribute is transient or not .

columns.name: IMPORT_MAPPABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies, whether the Attribute has to be visible in the Mapping Screen or Not.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: It specifies default value of the attribute, set at its consumer VO level.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_FLAGS
columns.description: This column is used to store attribute flags, e g: 7 means in binary its 111, each bit represents one flag

columns.name: LABEL_RESID
columns.description: It specifies the label resource id of an attribute

columns.name: ATTR_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: It Specifies description of the attributes

columns.name: ALIAS_NAME
columns.description: Alias Name for the corresponding Attribute

columns.name: DEPENDS_ON
columns.description: Column used to save the attribute dependencies for the object

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_DEF_TYPE
columns.description: This column specifies the control type of an attribute.
